entities.name: AKAP9
observations: Common AKAP9 variants/haplotypes modified QTc, cardiac-event risk, and disease severity among carriers of KCNQ1 p.Ala341Val in a South African founder cohort.
AKAP9 is distinct from AKAP9-primary LQT11: common variants acted as modifiers in KCNQ1-positive LQT1, whereas pathogenic AKAP9 variants can independently cause LQT11.

entities.name: LQT1
observations: In 168 carriers of identical KCNQ1 p.Ala341Val, AKAP9 rs11772585 T/TACT was associated with 218% higher cardiac-event risk, rs7808587 GG with 74% higher risk, and rs2282972 T/CATT with 53% lower risk; rs2961024 GG/CGCG was associated with age-dependent QTc increase irrespective of KCNQ1 status.
Direct evidence is primarily from one 2014 South African founder-population study and lacks broad independent replication in the available results.

entities.name: PMID:25087618 AKAP9 modifier
observations: The study held the pathogenic KCNQ1 p.Ala341Val genotype constant and tested whether AKAP9 polymorphisms explained differences in QTc, cardiac events, and disease severity.
